Allocation and spare capacity额度与空余资源

A clear support route明确的支持路径

Reported figures (about 5% / 48,000 node hours), spare capacity and the individual wait remain unverified. Bristol internal allocation and national AIRR are separate routes.反馈中的数字（约 5%／48,000 node hours）、空余容量及个案等待时间尚未核实。Bristol 内部分配与国家 AIRR 是不同渠道。
